Me & Snoop
About

Analyst. Seller. Problem solver.

I spent ten years selling graphics cards to distributors around the world at GIGABYTE and MSI.

Along the way I kept noticing how much data was sitting there, waiting to be dug into. So I started doing my own research and building small tools to save the team time, and I got hooked.

That curiosity took me to USC Marshall. Now I bring sales, analytics and AI together, and I especially love automating the repetitive work so people can focus on decisions.

Process

My approach

  1. 01

    Ask

    Start from the business question, not the dataset.

  2. 02

    Collect

    Pull and clean the data with SQL, Python or a crawler.

  3. 03

    Analyze

    Control for seasonality, baselines and outliers.

  4. 04

    Tell the story

    One dashboard, one recommendation, one number.

  5. 05

    Move the number

    Follow it through until it shows up in revenue.
